map.打样阶段估算单件总成本并倒推建议零售价: At the sampling stage estimate the total cost per unit and back-solve the suggested retail price
map.报价要不要含税与运费？: Should the quote include tax and freight?
map.核价时拆分面料、辅料、加工、其他费用占比: When pricing, break down fabric, trims, processing and other cost shares
map.裁床 3%–8%，格料或条纹对花可到 10%–15%，按版型复杂度定。: The cutting loss is usually 3%-8% for plain fabric and can reach 10%-15% for plaid or striped matching, depending on the complexity of the pattern.
map.调利润率或损耗率做报价敏感性分析: Adjust the profit margin or loss rate for a quote sensitivity analysis
map.输入面料单价、幅宽、单件用料与加工费等参数，核算面料及成衣的用料成本与加工费用，: Enter fabric unit price, width, usage per garment and processing fees to account for fabric and garment material cost and processing cost, totaling the cost per unit for quick sampling quotes and production cost control.
map.通常报价含工费与料，税运另议；大货核价应明确贸易条款（FOB/EXW 等）。: Quotes usually include labour and material, with tax and freight discussed separately; pricing for bulk orders should state the trade terms (FOB/EXW etc.) explicitly.
